doc.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Later recordings: Let's Hang Out
summary: The latest release adds Terence Blanchard and Jimmy Heath.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: You have done several more recording projects with different configurations . . .
Some. Right. The most recent recording was Let's Hang Out on Verve/Polygram. In addition to the quintet, we added Terence Blanchard on trumpet on

two cuts; and we switched tenor saxophonists on one or two cuts from Ralph Moore, who was my regular saxophonist, to Jimmy Heath, who is a dear friend. That came out as Let's Hang Out. That's the current release at the moment.
